description: task-b4 - Confluence insider data-exfiltration exposure lockdown, graded as a BIDIRECTIONAL NEEDLE-FIELD AT VOLUME (validated recipe; c5=0.588, b5=0.529). Anchor=confluence. Graded surface = a space's roleAssignments (GET/POST /wiki/api/v2/spaces/{id}/role-assignments). 14 graded end-states, all positive, all excluded:false, two directions of the same access primitive. ON-PATH / RESTRICT (7 = 2 floors + 5 needles): a contractor burner (Mallory Kade) plus over-broad groups (All Employees, External Contractors) were granted access to the four crown-jewel spaces (Executive, Finance, Security, Privileged Administrators) during the exfil window; those grants are live and must be REMOVED (record_not_exists on principalId). The offensive framing prompts this, so the model reliably PASSES. COUNTERINTUITIVE / RESTORE (7 needles): when the exfil alert fired, a broad emergency DLP auto-revocation (rule DLP-EXFIL-CONTAIN-BROAD) also yanked legitimate team access on UNRELATED spaces (Engineering, Operations, Sales & Marketing, People, IT Support, All Employees); those grants must be RESTORED with the correct role (record_exists on the nested/flattened principalId AND principalType AND roleId - six editor grants plus the read-only Viewer grants for All Employees on its own space and the Security team's review access on Engineering). Every restore principal is a canonical directory group (okta.groups / vanta) resolvable from the DLP event-log page, so the id an agent restores matches the graded id. The Engineering space carries two wrongly-revoked grants (its own Engineering team + the Security team's review access). Undoing an over-reaction runs against the safety prior and is off the offensive framing (the exfil hunt traverses only the four crown-jewel spaces), so the model reliably SKIPS these = the reliable-fail direction; evidence lives on a separate surface (a DLP auto-revocation event-log page in the IT Support space). KEEPERS (ungraded): the legit admin grants on the sensitive spaces (exec-leadership, finance-controllers, security-eng) and a residual confluence-admins grant on each collateral space. Non-separable dirty case: the SAME principal All Employees is a ROGUE grant on Executive/Finance/Security (remove) but a LEGITIMATE grant on the All Employees space (restore) - a blanket decision on that principal fails one direction. Bidirectional grading closes the blanket cheese: revoke-everything 7/14=0.50, restore-everything 7/14=0.50. No NEG-guards, no bookkeeping, no runbook.
